Corporate Oath

You signed with a megacorp — and the ink was ensouled. A sliver of your own soul is written into the contract as collateral, which is why the corp trusts you with power armor and live ordnance instead of a pension. Your Ward is whoever or whatever the current contract names: a VIP, a convoy, an asset, an objective. Command can reassign your Ward between engagements as terms are renegotiated above your head.

The Answer

Triggers the instant your named Ward is struck. You close distance and strike whoever dealt the damage, and the debt comes due whether they meant to incur it or not.

Vows (spend Leverage)

Two Vows per Oath — full crunch in What You Learned. Further Vows are picked up as Sworn feats.

  • Collateral Ward — redirect a portion of harm meant for your Ward onto yourself, on demand.
  • Repossession Notice — serve a foe formal notice that something of theirs is now collateral; it owes a penalty on its next Will save.
